offers.product: HMB Calcium + Citrulline Malate + Vitamin D3
offers.subclass: Calcium HMB salt with citrulline malate and vitamin D3
offers.basis: Official back label states 2 scoops (6.6 g), 3000 mg calcium hydroxyl methyl butyrate (CaHMB), 3000 mg L-citrulline DL-malate and 15 mcg vitamin D3 per serving; label net weight is 100 g.
offers.notes: CaHMB is the declared calcium salt mass. Free HMB payload and free L-citrulline payload are not specified and are not inferred. The product is a blend. Approximate 15 servings is not used as the cost divisor.

offers.subclass: Calcium HMB salt with vitamin D3
offers.basis: Official current product nutritional-information table states two vegetarian capsules per serving with calcium hydroxyl methyl butyrate (CaHMB) 1000 mg and vitamin D3 3.32 mcg. Retail pack is 120 capsules.
offers.notes: The declared 1000 mg is calcium HMB salt mass per two capsules. Free HMB payload and elemental calcium are not inferred. Generic goal-based dosing elsewhere on the page is not the label serving basis.

offers.subclass: Calcium HMB with explicitly declared HMB payload
offers.basis: Official unflavoured supplement-facts table states one 3000 mg scoop: calcium beta-hydroxy beta-methylbutyrate monohydrate (CaHMB) 3000 mg, of which HMB 2475 mg and labelled calcium 465 mg. Net size and Unflavored choice are matched to one exact child ID.
offers.notes: HMB payload 2475 mg is explicitly declared by the manufacturer, not a molecular conversion calculated by this catalog. The 3000 mg calcium HMB compound and 2475 mg HMB payload overlap and must not be added together. No free-acid HMB equivalent or calories are inferred. Official exact child finalPrice is published inclusive of tax in INR, but child-level availability is absent from public configurable data; stock must be confirmed.
